selected.why: Original TSPTW insertion construction with neighbourhood insert, reoptimization, feasibility/backtracking, and remove-reinsert post-optimization
steps: Build route by inserting at each step a vertex into its neighbourhood on the current route
Check feasibility of the remaining route; backtrack when needed
After a feasible route, post-optimize by successive removal and reinsertion of all vertices
selected.not_the_original: Insertion into a partial tour is not select_next_node. Not Solomon I1; Gendreau et al. generalized insertion for TSPTW.
